en: Sepia-toned aerial or elevated view of a valley settlement with a large hilltop complex dominating the left side, likely a castle with a tall tower and church-like spire. Below it is a river or stream with tracks or a road running alongside, bordered by numerous small houses and gardens. Forested hills surround the village, and open fields lie in the distance. In the upper-right area of the image is the printed caption "Weesenstein i. Sa."
